responsibility: This header defines the public interface to the mc-boot runtime's dynamic string subsystem. It introduces the opaque DynamicStrings_String handle and declares the full service surface for creating, destroying, concatenating, slicing, comparing, transforming, indexing, exporting, and debug-tracking heap-backed strings that other runtime modules use as their common higher-level text representation.
same_name_distinction: Public API half of the DynamicStrings pair: unlike GDynamicStrings.cc, it keeps `DynamicStrings_String` opaque and declares the operations without exposing the internal record layouts, descriptor state, or allocation-tracking implementation.
